summary_en: Mizuho Financial Group authorized the acquisition of up to 35 million shares (1.4% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 20 billion yen through market purchases via a trust arrangement between November 16, 2026 and February 28, 2027. All acquired shares will be cancelled on March 23, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Resolution on Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Resolution on Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, Mizuho Financial Group's Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock under Article 156 of the Companies Act and subsequent cancellation under Article 178. The company will acquire up to 35 million shares of its common stock, representing 1.4% of outstanding shares (calculated against 2,414,586,287 shares as of September 30, 2026), for a maximum expenditure of 20 billion yen through market purchases executed via a trust arrangement.

The acquisition period runs from November 16, 2026 through February 28, 2027. Upon completion of the purchase phase, the company will cancel all acquired shares on March 23, 2027. No specific price ceiling was disclosed; the authorization establishes only a monetary limit.

The company stated that this buyback program aligns with its capital policy aimed at achieving an optimal balance among capital adequacy, growth investments, and shareholder returns. Under its stated shareholder return policy, Mizuho pursues both progressive increases in per-share dividends and opportunistic share repurchases, targeting a total payout ratio of 50% or higher by taking into account business performance, capital position, stock price levels, and growth investment opportunities.
